name: Two-Level Grid Ray Traversal
definition: A traversal algorithm for two-level grids that modifies the DDA algorithm to step through top-level cells and then treat each top cell as a uniform grid for leaf traversal.
summary: Two-Level Grid Ray Traversal is a hierarchical ray-grid traversal algorithm that modifies the standard DDA to step through top-level cells and leaf grids, distinguishing itself by reusing decision variables between levels to minimize computational overhead.
